definitions.explanation: The number of people, especially when counting whether there are enough for a task or event.

examples.japanese: {頭数|あたまかず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頭数|あたまかず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the headcount before the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}られる→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、{頭数|あたまかず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえる⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{精一杯|せいいっぱい}→精一杯：13774_seiippai⟧だった。
examples.english: So few players were available that just making up the numbers was all we could manage.

notes:
Often treats people as numbers rather than for their ability, as in {頭数|あたまかず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえる (to make up the numbers).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頭数|あたまかず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to be short of people
- {頭数|あたまかず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえる: to make up the numbers
- {頭数|あたまかず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to count someone in

WATCH OUT:
Read {頭数|とうすう}, the same kanji mean the number of animals (head of cattle).
